bio_en: Aram Aramian, a native of Karin and at one time secretary of a parish council, joined the ARF in 1890 at about twenty and became known as Ashot and Tatul. A member of the Karin committee, at the end of August 1891 he killed Khachatur Kerektsian, whom the committee considered an obstacle to the cause, and had to leave the city, spending a year in the Caucasus until the ARF General Congress of 1892. He held that a terrorist should never flee but declare himself the sole author of his act so that others would not suffer. Arrested in Karin in June 1896 and betrayed by the informer 'Azrail' (Tigran Gevorgian of Khnus), he wrote from prison expecting the gallows, and on 9/21 August 1899 he was hanged in Erzurum, placing the noose around his own neck after crying 'Long live the revolution!'.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Year of hanging deduced from the Droshak issue of 30 Sept 1899 (9/21 August fell on a Monday in 1899, as the text says).
